Community Fedora container setup for Resolve Free or Studio 21.1 on Linux using Docker or Distrobox. Documents AMD ROCm/OpenCL and NVIDIA container setup. Provider tested AMD/X11; NVIDIA and Wayland validation remains incomplete. Supply the official Resolve installer and any required Studio license separately.
Reviewed source revision, not a published software release.
Current setup targets Resolve 21.2 build 6. This is the container target, not a promise about all earlier installers.
